name: Democratic Republic of the Congo (1997–2006)
description: A blue field with a large yellow five-pointed star in the centre and six smaller yellow stars in a column along the hoist.
history: After the fall of Mobutu in 1997 Laurent-Désiré Kabila's government restored a flag closely modelled on the 1960 flag of independence, with the large star and six stars for the provinces. It was replaced on 18 February 2006 by the present flag under the new constitution.
